dc_eval_cbrn.quote: we have decided to treat gpt-5-thinking as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain under our Preparedness Framework
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Threshold determination plus bio eval scores.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: The gpt-5 model series does not meet the threshold for high cyber risk.
dc_eval_cyber.note: Threshold determination plus CTF, Cyber Range, Pattern Labs results.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: It is unlikely that gpt-5-thinking would be capable of rogue replication.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: METR replication/AI R&D conclusions, time horizon 2h15m.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: CBRN uplift for novices and experts; persuasion, autonomy, and deception; jailbreak
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Persuasion named as a red-teamed harm area; only an aggregate 'frontier domain' finding, no persuasion-specific result.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: They found that gpt-5-thinking takes deceptive actions in roughly 4% of trajectories, lower than the 8% rate of OpenAI o3.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Apollo covert action and evaluation-awareness rates.

framework_threshold.quote: we have decided to treat gpt-5-thinking as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain under our Preparedness Framework
framework_threshold.note: Model placed at High under Preparedness Framework.

ext_test_any.quote: this work comprised more than 9,000 hours of work from over 400 external testers and experts.

ext_test_named_org.quote: METR, a research nonprofit that works on assessing whether frontier AI systems could pose catastrophic risks to society, evaluated gpt-5-thinking for risks from autonomy.
ext_test_named_org.note: Named org; also Apollo, Pattern Labs, SecureBio, FAR.AI, Gray Swan, Microsoft AI Red Team.

ext_test_government.quote: we provided early access to gpt-5-thinking to the U.S. Center on Artificial Intelligence Standards and Innovation (CAISI)
ext_test_government.note: CAISI and UK AISI evaluated the model.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We sorted red team campaigns into three groups: Pre-Deployment Research (conducted on an internal testing platform)
ext_test_timing_stated.note: External red team campaigns include pre-deployment research; also 'early access' for CAISI/UK AISI.

safeguards_training.quote: We trained gpt-5-thinking and gpt-5-thinking-mini to follow OpenAI's safety policies

safeguards_runtime.quote: we've deployed a two tiered system of real-time, automated oversight surrounding the model to monitor and block unsafe prompts and generations

safeguards_access.quote: We may require developers to provide additional information, such as payment or identity information, in order to access gpt-5-thinking and gpt-5-thinking-mini.
safeguards_access.note: KYC-style access tied to bio risk; also Trusted Access Program.

safeguards_weights.quote: we take a defense-in-depth approach to protecting our model weights, relying on a combination of access control, infrastructure hardening, egress controls, and monitoring.
safeguards_weights.note: Weight theft protections applied to GPT-5 models.
